aligned-policy.purpose: Negative control: both sentinel names exist and both policies prohibit runner-based escalation, so no near-name or contradiction finding is emitted.

bootstrap-policy.purpose: Missing SENTINTEL.md, near-name SENTINEL.md runner escalation contradiction, escaping instruction link, placeholder selector digest, and unavailable issuectl recovery command.

claim-drift.purpose: Task/claim state drift, retained terminal claims, orphan Task identity, replaced immutable identity, unsafe/mismatched scope, stale Task pointer, and missing next action.

clean.purpose: One canonical active Task and exact claim produce zero findings and prove the detector is not inherently fail-open or fail-always.

marker-and-refs.purpose: Undefined [d], inline and multiline hidden full REFs, verified/pending/local placeholders, short hash, duplicate authoritative REF, unreachable full hash, and nonterminal closure REF.

prerequisites-and-parent.purpose: Task and Feature missing endpoints/wrong left sides, partial and fully malformed relation lists, syntactic cycle, terminal-before-prerequisite, and eligible parent-package closure.
sources: AGENTS.md autonomous backlog repair and parent-package closure rules

notes: Fixtures are minimal semantic extracts, not copied full backlogs or claims.
All commit IDs and identities are synthetic development-test values.
Expected findings are asserted by stable rule ID; source line provenance explains the historical pattern represented.
